title: Workspace-Comms Agent-Turn-Trace Contract
description: SSOT JSON-Schema (draft 2020-12) for one AGENT TURN TRACE — the observability record a workspace runtime produces per turn and the platform's GET /workspaces/:id/traces proxy reads back for the canvas Traces tab. VENDOR-NEUTRAL: this describes the trace DATA + the tagging convention, not any backend (Langfuse is the current concrete sink; the shape does not name it). SSOT-first: both agent surfaces (molecule_runtime container agents and molecule_external_workspace BYO-compute agents) emit this shape, and molecule-core's reader filters by `workspace_id`, so the three cannot drift. THE TAGGING CONVENTION IS LOAD-BEARING: every producer MUST tag/label the trace with `workspace_id` because the platform reader's ONLY filter is `tags=<workspace_id>`; an untagged trace is invisible to the canvas. Field requiredness: only `workspace_id` is statically required (an untagged trace is unroutable); the rest are best-effort so a producer that cannot capture, say, the system prompt still emits a routable trace.

workspace_id.description: The producing workspace's id (self). The trace MUST carry this as a backend tag/label: molecule-core traces.go filters Langfuse by `tags=<workspace_id>`, so this is the sole routing key from producer to the canvas Traces tab.

name.description: Human-facing trace name. Conventionally 'agent-turn'. Optional; producers should set it for a readable Traces tab.

input.description: The user/inbound message text that drove this turn — the turn's input.

output.description: The agent's reply text for this turn — the turn's output.

system_prompt.description: The CONSOLIDATED system prompt sent to the LLM this turn (base platform identity + role/prompt-files + injected instructions). This is the 'what we actually send to the LLM' view the Traces tab surfaces on the generation.

model.description: The model id the turn ran against (e.g. anthropic/claude-opus-4-8).

tool_uses.description: Ordered tool names the agent invoked during the turn. Empty for turns that used no tools.

session_id.description: Opaque per-conversation session id, when the runtime tracks one, so multiple turns group into one Traces-tab session.

steps.description: Ordered per-turn steps — the model's reasoning + tool decisions IN SEQUENCE, so the trace shows HOW the agent decided, not just the final answer. CAPABILITY-GATED per runtime: each runtime fills what its CLI/SDK surfaces. A `thinking` step carries the reasoning `text`; a `tool_call` step carries the tool `name` + `input` (args) + `result` (output) — a runtime whose CLI hides tool results (e.g. claude-code's Agent SDK, which executes tools inside the CLI and never returns the result block to the runtime) emits `tool_call` steps with `result` absent. Producers serialize `input`/`result` to strings so the shape is uniform across runtimes; the trace backend may render them richer.

kind.description: Step kind: 'thinking' (a reasoning block) or 'tool_call' (a tool invocation).

text.description: Reasoning text — present on a 'thinking' step.

name.description: Tool name — present on a 'tool_call' step.

input.description: Serialized tool input/args — present on a 'tool_call' step when the runtime exposes it.

result.description: Serialized tool result/output — present on a 'tool_call' step ONLY when the runtime surfaces it (absent for CLI runtimes that hide tool results).
